query:
SELECT 1 AS "one!: i64" FROM blocks b
           WHERE b.space_id IS NULL
             AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND (
                 b.block_type = 'tag'
                 OR (
                     b.block_type = 'page'
                     AND NOT EXISTS (
                         SELECT 1 FROM block_properties
                         WHERE block_id = b.id
                           AND key = 'is_space'
                           AND value_text = 'true'
                     )
                 )
             )
           LIMIT 1
